Control.name: LibConsoleMenuGamepadSlider
Control.OnInitialized: -- Child OnInitialized replaces ZO_GamepadOptionsSliderRow's; re-bind Name/Slider. self.label = self:GetNamedChild("Name") self.slider = self:GetNamedChild("Slider") self.GetHeight = function(control) local valueLabel = control:GetNamedChild("ValueLabel") local valueHeight = 0 if valueLabel and not valueLabel:IsHidden() then valueHeight = valueLabel:GetTextHeight() + 4 end return control.label:GetTextHeight() + control.slider:GetHeight() + valueHeight end

Control.name: LibConsoleMenuGamepadEditBox
Control.OnInitialized: self.isLcmMultiLine = false self.GetHeight = function(control) local nameControl = control:GetNamedChild("Name") local editControl = control:GetNamedChild("ValueTextFieldEdit") local nameHeight = 0 if nameControl and not nameControl:IsHidden() then nameHeight = nameControl:GetTextHeight() end local editHeight = editControl and editControl:GetHeight() or 0 return nameHeight + editHeight end

Control.name: LibConsoleMenuGamepadEditBoxMultiline
Control.OnInitialized: self.isLcmMultiLine = true self.GetHeight = function(control) local nameControl = control:GetNamedChild("Name") local editControl = control:GetNamedChild("ValueTextFieldEdit") local nameHeight = 0 if nameControl and not nameControl:IsHidden() then nameHeight = nameControl:GetTextHeight() end local editHeight = editControl and editControl:GetHeight() or 0 return nameHeight + editHeight end

Control.name: LibConsoleMenuGamepadDropdown
Control.OnInitialized: ZO_SharedGamepadEntry_OnInitialized(self) self.label = self:GetNamedChild("Name") if not self.dropdown then local dropdownControl = self:GetNamedChild("Dropdown") self.dropdown = ZO_ComboBox_ObjectFromContainer(dropdownControl) end self.GetHeight = function(control) local nameHeight = control.label and control.label:GetTextHeight() or 0 local dropdownHeight = control.dropdown and control.dropdown:GetHeight() or 28 return nameHeight + dropdownHeight end

Control.name: LibConsoleMenuGamepadChecklist
Control.OnInitialized: ZO_SharedGamepadEntry_OnInitialized(self) self.label = self:GetNamedChild("Name") if not self.dropdown then local dropdownControl = self:GetNamedChild("Dropdown") self.dropdown = ZO_ComboBox_ObjectFromContainer(dropdownControl) end self.GetHeight = function(control) local nameHeight = control.label and control.label:GetTextHeight() or 0 local dropdownHeight = control.dropdown and control.dropdown:GetHeight() or 28 return nameHeight + dropdownHeight end
